prompt: Create a highly detailed fantasy anime illustration of a vast treetop city built around an enormous ancient tree, viewed from a high wooden café terrace in warm afternoon sunlight. Add a large glass conservatory-like building with a steep turquoise roof on the right-center, a small red-and-white circus tent near the lower center, and suspended walkways disappearing into dense foliage. Use intricate cinematic fantasy anime background art, ultra-rich linework, painterly textures, glowing sunbeams through leaves, teal-and-gold color grading, high-frequency architectural detail, magical realism, deep perspective, no text, no watermark, vertical composition.
